consts.name: dcvInnerMajorPlaneCount
consts.comment: the six major elemental planes (Fire, Earth, Air, Water, Positive Energy, Negative Energy) plus the twelve minor (four para-, eight quasi-), arranged on a sphere with the Prime and Ethereal inside.

consts.name: dcvInnerMinorPlaneCount
consts.comment: the twelve minor planes: the para- (Smoke, Ice, Ooze, Magma) between the elementals, the quasi- (Lightning, Steam, Radiance, Minerals, Vacuum, Salt, Ash, Dust) between the elementals and the energy planes.

consts.name: dcvBreathlessDieSides
consts.comment: except on the plane of elemental Air, normal breathing is impossible in the inner planes: the unprotected traveler suffocates or drowns in 2d4 rounds (this pin, the die side; or use the DSG holding-breath rules).

consts.name: dcvFallRateFeet
consts.comment: a chosen "down" without supporting mass drops the traveler 1,000 feet per round; reverse the direction to slow, reverse one full round then negate to stop; momentum is conserved and a strike deals falling damage (1d6 per 10 feet, 20d6 max).

consts.name: dcvGuideBorderHours
consts.comment: guided travel times: 10-100 hours to a border with another inner plane, 100-1,000 hours to a specific location within a plane; a polymorphed self-guide doubles all times (not truly a native).

consts.name: dcvGuideInducementGP
consts.comment: the elemental guide inducement rate: 100 gp worth per hour of service - gems for Earth, rare wood for Fire, perfume for Air, scents and potions for Water; genies take 100 gp or magic, and fight alongside for magic.

consts.name: dcvHumanLoneMinLevel
consts.comment: human travelers are almost always in groups (use the p. 16 chart for number and levels); a lone human traveler in the inner planes is never less than 20th level.

bools.name: dcvInbornHostility
bools.comment: the inborn hostility: all eighteen inner planes are hostile to life not of the inner planes, Prime Material life in particular - wander only with specific protection or stay in the Border Ethereal.

bools.name: dcvNativesSeeBorderEthereal
bools.comment: inner-plane natives see into the Ethereal from their home plane, attack ethereal beings, and can enter the Ethereal (only from home) to pursue - but cannot reach the Prime without aid or a free-standing gate.

bools.name: dcvTimeFasterInner
bools.comment: the subjective-time reversal: one true day equals two subjective days in the inner planes - the traveler tires twice as quickly but rests and learns spells twice per elemental day; healing and research run faster.

bools.name: dcvLocalGravity
bools.comment: gravity is determined by the intelligent beings in the area: any sentient being chooses his own "down"; undecided means weightless; hierophants of sufficient level are treated as natives.

bools.name: dcvUltravisionFails
bools.comment: ultravision does not function in the inner planes (no reflected ultraviolet radiation); vision limits vary by plane - para-planes take the more restrictive neighbor, quasi-planes take the adjoining elemental plane.

bools.name: dcvUnguidedRandomDirection
bools.comment: the unaided traveler moves at normal rate but at the end of every turn the DM rolls a random direction - without an objective in sight or an elemental guide, the infinite plane defeats navigation.

bools.name: dcvElementalImmunityHome
bools.comment: natives cannot be harmed by attacks of their own elemental type while in the inner planes - a fireball against salamanders inspires derision; Negative natives shrug energy drain.
